doctrines.name: Sword Creed
doctrines.motto: One clean edge answers more than a hundred arguments.
doctrines.blurb: A hall of duelists. Few members, but every one of them a blade.

doctrines.name: Alchemy Creed
doctrines.motto: What the body lacks, the furnace can supply.
doctrines.blurb: A hall of refiners. Fewer swords, but the treasury fills faster.

doctrines.name: Formation Creed
doctrines.motto: A wall is only the outermost line of a formation.
doctrines.blurb: A hall of wardens. The widest roster and a modest levy.
